viewing_check: Read the base in hand with a loupe. A senior artist would normally be an incised monogram (Simmance ES, Butler FAB, Marshall MVM, Hannah Barlow BHB, Florence Barlow FEB); the small painted blue/black mark and faint incised letters here look more like assistant or decorator marks, the cheaper end. Check the raised white tube-lined petals, rim and foot for chips and touch-ups, the neck for hairlines, and that the base isn't drilled. No Australian sold examples turned up. The closest outside sale (same form and size, different flowers) was a pair at £49.50 on eBay, and UK eBay sales of comparable Lambeth vases ran about AU$96-279.
